P.name: Cultivation of War
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zaahen''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Determination'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} damaged by his {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}}, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking up to 12 times. After the duration, the stacks expire by {{pp|1;2;3;4;5|0 to 2 by 0.5|type=seconds elapsed|label=Stacks lost|formula=Loses 1 stack immediately, increasing by 1 every interval.|label1=Seconds}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Determination:}} For each stack, '''Zaahen''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|1.5 + (2.8-1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD}}. At maximum stacks, '''Zaahen''' becomes filled with ''Determination'', causing him to double the bonus to {{as|{{pp|1.5*12*2 + (2.8*12*2-1.5*12*2)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD}}.

Periodically, if '''Zaahen''' would take {{tip|death|lethal damage}} while at maximum stacks of ''Determination'', he refreshes its duration and enters {{tip|resurrection}} for 4 seconds: becoming {{tip|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. Additionally, he {{tt|restores|Not considered healing}}{{ft|{{as|{{pp|30 to 75 for|1;6;11;16|key=%}} of his '''maximum''' health}}|{{as|{{pp|30/(4/0.125) to 75/(4/0.125) for|1;6;11;16|key=%}} of his '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.125}} seconds}}over the duration. Afterwards, he revives himself and refreshes the duration of ''Determination''.

Q.name: The Darkin Glaive
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Zaahen''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and gain {{as|{{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}}}. {{tip|On-attack}}, he strikes the target twice. If the target was a champion, minion, or monster, he also {{tip|heal|heals}} himself. The strikes deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and the heal is reduced to 50% against minions and monsters.

Each strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Zaahen|crit_base}}/2|50|base=50}}|critical damage}}|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}}}{{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|15 to 75}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20 to 40}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|15/2 to 75/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100/2}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20/2 to 40/2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Champion Healing|{{as|{{ap|5 to 9}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}|Non-Champion Healing|{{as|{{ap|5*0.5 to 9*0.5}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}}}
Q.description2: After {{fd|1.5}} seconds of using the empowered attack, ''The Darkin Glaive'' can be recast within the next 4 seconds at no additional cost, modifying it with a new effect.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Zaahen''' empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{as|{{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knock up}} the target for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
Q.description5: ''Both casts of The Darkin Glaive {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Zaahen's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Dreaded Return
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zaahen''' extends his glaive in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Upon reaching maximum range, all enemies hit are dealt {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|pulled}} 225 units toward '''Zaahen'''.

E.name: Aureate Rush
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zaahen''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location. Upon arrival, he flourishes his glaive to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description2: Enemies hit by the outer edge are dealt {{ccs|{{as|50% increased physical damage}}|physical}} and {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}}, with the latter capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Increased Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 6}}% of the target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
E.description3: ''Aureate Rush'' deals {{as|50 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against monsters.

R.name: Grim Deliverance
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zaahen''' gains {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} over the cast time, then {{tip|dash|launches}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} into the air to the target location. He then slams his glaive down after a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, unleashing a shockwave that deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|heal|heals}} him for each {{tip|champion}} hit.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|250 to 550}} {{as|(+ 200% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Healing per Champion hit|{{ap|250*0.33 to 550*0.33}} {{as|(+ {{ap|200*0.33}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description3: '''Zaahen''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and gains 50% [[damage reduction]] from the start of the cast time. He retains these effects as well as the {{tip|displacement immunity}} during the delay before the slam and for {{tt|up-to an additional {{fd|0.25}} seconds|See notes}} afterwards.
